description: This file defines FastAPI routes for managing roles in a role-based access control (RBAC) system. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting roles, and assigning/removing permissions to/from roles within an organization. It also includes internal utilities for database session handling and auditing actions.

classes.name: RoleUpdate
classes.description: Data model for updating role attributes (name and description).

methods.name: get_db()
methods.description: Creates and yields a SQLAlchemy database session, ensuring closure after use.

methods.name: None _audit(db: Session, org_id: int, user_id: Optional[int], action: str, resource_type: str, resource_id: Optional[str], details: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Internal helper function to log audit entries for actions performed on roles.

methods.name: RoleOut create_role( payload: RoleCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("roles:write")), )
methods.description: Creates a new role within the organization; requires 'roles:write' permission.

methods.name: List[RoleOut] list_roles( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("roles:read")), )
methods.description: Lists all roles within the current user's organization; requires 'roles:read' permission.

methods.name: RoleOut get_role( role_id: int = Path(..., description="Role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("roles:read")), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific role by ID within the user's organization; requires 'roles:read'.

methods.name: RoleOut update_role( updates: RoleUpdate, role_id: int = Path(..., description="Role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("roles:write")), )
methods.description: Updates the name and/or description of a role; requires 'roles:write'.

methods.name: None delete_role( role_id: int = Path(..., description="Role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("roles:write")), )
methods.description: Deletes a role and its associated permissions; requires 'roles:write'.

methods.name: RoleOut assign_permission_to_role( role_id: int = Path(..., description="Role ID"), permission_id: int = Path(..., description="Permission ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("roles:write")), )
methods.description: Assigns a permission to a role, scoped within the organization; requires 'roles:write'.

methods.name: RoleOut remove_permission_from_role( role_id: int = Path(..., description="Role ID"), permission_id: int = Path(..., description="Permission ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("roles:write")), )
methods.description: Removes a permission from a role within the organization; requires 'roles:write'.
